provenance.notes: Official AMD spec: 3.8 GHz base, up to 5.2 GHz boost, 65W default TDP. Includes minimal integrated graphics (RDNA2, 2 CUs).
Official AMD spec: 3.9 GHz base, up to 5.4 GHz boost, 65W default TDP (reduced from 105W on the 7600X). Includes minimal integrated graphics (RDNA2, 2 CUs, 2200 MHz).

AMD official page did not surface a full clock table in search; 3.8 GHz base / 5.5 GHz boost and 65W default TDP (reduced from 105W on the 7700X) corroborated across wccftech review and Puget Systems 9800X3D comparison review. Includes minimal integrated graphics (RDNA2, 2 CUs).

AMD official product page did not surface a full clock table in search; 4.7 GHz base / 5.2 GHz boost and 120W default TDP corroborated across Tom's Hardware, TechPowerUp, LanOC Reviews, and Hardware Busters reviews. First X3D chip with 2nd-gen 3D V-Cache positioned below the CCD (rather than above) for improved thermals, and the first fully unlocked/overclockable X3D part. 96MB total L3 cache (32MB + 64MB stacked). Includes minimal integrated graphics (RDNA2, 2 CUs).

provenance.source_name: AMD.com (official product page, via B&H official listing)
provenance.notes: AMD's official published specs (4.4 GHz base, 5.6 GHz boost, 120W default TDP), corroborated via vortez.net and MKAU Gaming reviews. Two CCDs with 6 active cores each. Includes minimal integrated graphics (RDNA2, 2 CUs).

provenance.source_name: AMD.com (official product page confirmed SKU) / B&H official listing (corroborated clocks)
provenance.notes: AMD official page confirmed SKU but full clock table did not surface in search; B&H's official AMD-sourced listing confirms 4.4 GHz base, 5.5 GHz max boost, 128MB L3 cache (fully enabled 3D V-Cache, unlike the 7900X3D's partial config), 120W TDP. Retains non-X3D clock speeds, unlike prior-generation X3D chips which typically saw clock reductions. Launched alongside the 9950X3D, March 2025. Includes minimal integrated graphics (RDNA2, 2 CUs).

Official AMD spec confirms 5.7 GHz max boost clock; base clock (4.3 GHz, 200 MHz lower than the 7950X) and 170W/230W TDP/PPT corroborated via Tom's Hardware and vortez.net reviews. Flagship 16-core Ryzen 9000 desktop part. Includes minimal integrated graphics (RDNA2, 2 CUs).

AMD official product page did not surface a full clock table in search; GamersNexus confirms identical clocks to the non-X3D 9950X (4.3 GHz base, 5.7 GHz boost, 170W TDP) — unlike prior-gen X3D parts, this generation retains full clock speeds. 128MB L3 cache (one CCD stacked with 3D V-Cache), 145MB total cache including L2. Launched March 12, 2025, alongside the 9900X3D. Includes minimal integrated graphics (RDNA2, 2 CUs).
